evidence.text: Delivery-worker configuration mount rollout completed. Credential values and remote-provider validity were not checked.
Delivery provider returned HTTP 401 Unauthorized for credential label SYNTHETIC_KEY_DO_NOT_USE. Response omitted a reason code.
Retry returned HTTP 401 Unauthorized. The worker left the message pending for retry.
Redacted export for SYNTHETIC_KEY_DO_NOT_USE: expires_at=unavailable; revocation_state=unavailable; credential value=FAKE_NOT_A_SECRET. This export cannot establish expiry.
Delivery queue pending_messages=42. The sample does not identify unique recipients or establish message loss.
Worker /health returned HTTP 200; this endpoint checks process liveness without authenticating to the delivery provider.
Credential rotation planned for 09:15Z. status=scheduled; no execution record included.

Check provider-side credential expiry, revocation, scope and worker configuration. Any rotation requires operator approval. Verify a delivery attempt and queue progress after an approved change; do not infer expiry from HTTP 401 alone.
